name: ok-minimal-columns
note: the smallest valid list-spec — required columns map with one text column.

name: ok-shorthand-and-boolean-format
note: CellFormat polymorphism — a bare type string and a boolean both validate.

name: ok-sortable-sort-pagination-actions-empty-design
note: the read-structure 1급 slots all validate together (sort/pagination/actions/empty/design).

name: ok-compose-ref-patch-columns
note: $ref/$patch compose entry on the columns map (the SAME engine as form-spec). files resolve the base for the four-language engine; ajv ignores files and reads only spec.

name: ok-search-form-ref
note: search is input → a form-spec reference ($ref base + $patch overlay). files resolve the base form for the engine; ajv ignores files and reads only spec.

name: red-missing-columns
note: RED — columns is required; a list-spec without it is rejected. The 'required' shape check is meta-schema-only; the four-language engine (compose + forbidden-scan) has no shape opinion, so it passes (engine: pass).

name: red-forbidden-column-key
note: RED — a forbidden condition meta-key as a COLUMN key is rejected (ForbiddenKeyNames). The four-language engine catches this too: forbidden-scan rejects the key as a LOAD failure.

name: red-x-prefixed-column-key
note: RED — an x-prefixed comment-residue key as a COLUMN key is rejected (ForbiddenKeyNames pattern). The four-language engine catches this too: forbidden-scan rejects any surviving x{key}.

name: red-unknown-column-key
note: RED — a Column carries an out-of-1급 key (additionalProperties:false) — here a stray condition key. ajv rejects it as additionalProperties; show_if is ALSO a forbidden meta key, so the four-language engine catches it via forbidden-scan (a LOAD failure).

name: red-forbidden-key-in-format-options
note: RED — a forbidden meta-key one level below the open CellFormat options bucket is rejected. The four-language engine catches this too: forbidden-scan descends into the format bucket and rejects 'if' (a LOAD failure).

name: red-bad-sort-dir
note: RED — sort.dir is an enum (asc|desc); an unregistered value is rejected. Enum shape is meta-schema-only; the four-language engine has no enum opinion (engine: pass).

name: red-unknown-sort-key
note: RED — Sort is closed (field/dir only); an extra key is rejected. additionalProperties closure is meta-schema-only; 'nulls' is not a forbidden meta key, so the four-language engine passes (engine: pass).

name: red-unknown-pagination-key
note: RED — Pagination is closed (per_page/mode only); an extra key is rejected. additionalProperties closure is meta-schema-only; 'limit' is not a forbidden meta key, so the four-language engine passes (engine: pass).

name: red-bad-pagination-mode
note: RED — pagination.mode is an enum (pages|offset|cursor|none); an unregistered value is rejected. Enum shape is meta-schema-only; the four-language engine has no enum opinion (engine: pass).

name: red-unknown-list-top-key
note: RED — List is closed at the top (additionalProperties:false); a stray top key is rejected. Top-level closure is meta-schema-only; 'limit' is not a forbidden meta key, so the four-language engine passes (engine: pass).

name: red-unknown-action-key
note: RED — a ListAction object is closed; an out-of-1급 action key is rejected. additionalProperties closure is meta-schema-only; 'onclick' is not a forbidden meta key, so the four-language engine passes (engine: pass).

name: red-malformed-format-value
note: RED — a CellFormat is polymorphic boolean|string|{object}; an array (an unregistered format SHAPE) is rejected by anyOf. CellFormat polymorphism is meta-schema-only; the array carries no forbidden key, so the four-language engine passes (engine: pass).
